3442:5756.name: _ROI

useWhen: Inside Investment-amount or Investment Calculator when the headline expected-return figure must update with the amount preset
When reproducing the legacy calculator state for a given sample amount (1K, 4K, 20K, 300K, 400K, 2M)

3442:5756.compliance: Figures are projections: label them expected (متوقع), show net after the agency fee (1% of profit, never of capital) beside gross, and never imply a guaranteed return.

3442:6279.name: _Gross-profit

dontUseWhen: Never show gross without net; pair it with _Net-profit, or use Calculator / Metric row in Calculator v2

3442:6279.a11y: Announce as «إجمالي الربح» plus amount and currency.
3442:6279.compliance: Figures are projections: label them expected (متوقع), show net after the agency fee (1% of profit, never of capital) beside gross, and never imply a guaranteed return.

3442:6600.name: _Net-profit
3442:6600.description: Hidden figure atom for net profit after the investment agency fee in the legacy calculator, one variant per sample amount. It is the figure investors actually receive as profit.

Beside _Gross-profit so the fee deduction is explicit
dontUseWhen: Do not place on its own; use Investment-amount or Calculator / Results card
For other amounts use MoneyAmount
3442:6600.a11y: Announce as «صافي الأرباح» plus amount and currency.
3442:6600.compliance: Figures are projections: label them expected (متوقع), show net after the agency fee (1% of profit, never of capital) beside gross, and never imply a guaranteed return.

3442:6739.description: Promo-code entry row in the invest flow: a grey «إضافة رمز ترويجي» add row, or once applied a green chip with the code, the discount it gives (for example 50% off the investment agency fee) and a remove ×.

3442:6746.name: Investment-amount
